To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a method for robot camera calibration that is fast, accurate, and easy to implement.

1) we have developed a method for intrinsic camera and hand eye calibration on a robot using a single point, 2) the method is fast and easy to use and 3) it provides results on par with robot accuracy.

(a) a single point marker is a suitable calibration target for intrinsic camera and hand eye calibration of a robot vision system; (b) the proposed calibration routine provides high accuracy results on par with robot accuracy and can be completed in 3 minutes; (c) the proposed method for automatic testing and evaluation of camera calibration accuracy provides a reliable way of verifying the quality of the camera calibration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to calibrate a robot vision system for precision assembly tasks using a single point feature marker.
the problem of robot vision accuracy and how to achieve it with minimal impact to the production environment.
how to make the vision system more robust to changes in the robot's environment, which is important in the context of flexible production.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method for calibration of a robot vision system is a very good solution for industrial applications.

the proposed solution for camera and hand-eye intrinsic calibration is very efficient in the sense that it is fast, accurate and easy to use, which are all important features for a calibration routine that is supposed to be run frequently.
we have successfully demonstrated the feasibility of the proposed method for robot vision camera calibration.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a calibration procedure that is easy to use, accurate and fast, and can be used for robot calibration in a production environment.
it is now possible to do camera and hand-eye intrinsic calibration on a robot using a single point as a marker.
we have developed a calibration procedure that can be used for on line robot vision system calibration.

the robot vision system calibration is an important part of the system design, and should be done with care.
it is feasible to perform camera and hand-eye calibrations on a robot system using a point based approach, without using special purpose calibration objects.
the proposed method is a simple and effective way to calibrate robot cameras, and it is a valuable addition to the tool box of robot vision system integrators.
